subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should the repository accept these 13 executable GitHub Action revisions on a stable rebased head after all required checks complete?
rationale: Automated review found no patch defect, but it cannot authorize new third-party executable revisions in secret-bearing security, release, token, and agent workflows or decide whether the grouped upgrade's residual supply-chain risk is acceptable.

options.title: Approve stable-head pins
options.body: Wait for a stable rebased SHA and completed required gates, then have a CI/security owner approve and merge the exact revisions.

options.title: Split sensitive updates
options.body: Separate token, release, CodeQL, Docker, and Codex action upgrades if owners want independent validation or rollback boundaries.

recommendation.title: Approve stable-head pins
recommendation.body: Wait for a stable rebased SHA and completed required gates, then have a CI/security owner approve and merge the exact revisions.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is extensive recent ownership of the central CI workflow and its execution topology.
